items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) And SK Hynix Release Open HBF Standard For AI Memory
items.summary: SanDisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) and SK hynix have released a joint High Bandwidth Flash technical specification through the Open Compute Project. The new HBF standard targets AI focused memory solutions for data centers and AI inference systems. The announcement includes plans for an upcoming conference keynote and panel to discuss implementation and adoption by industry participants.
